definitions.explanation: A precious silvery-white metal used in jewelry, catalytic converters, and various industrial applications. The Japanese name literally means 'white gold'.

examples.japanese: {白金|はっきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧。
{白金|はっきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|きん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧な⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Platinum is a rarer metal than gold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白金|はっきん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm torn between choosing platinum or gold for the wedding rings.

notes: In jewelry contexts, ⟦プラチナ→プラチナ：11401_purachina⟧ (the loanword from English/Spanish) is more commonly used in advertising and everyday conversation, while {白金|はっきん} is the traditional Japanese term used in science and formal contexts. Note: {白金|しろかね} (read しろかね) is the place name for the Shirokane district in Tokyo. The element symbol is Pt. Related: ⟦プラチナ→プラチナ：11401_purachina⟧ (platinum — loanword, common in jewelry marketing), {金|きん} (gold), ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧ (silver).
